messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — couple clarifications so folks know next steps. Two asks: 1) Timeline for Dedicated GA (Ana mentioned Q3) — does that mean commit/contract window opens in July? 2) Who's owning the autoscaler runbook + config suggestions so we can share with customers?
ana: Short answer: GA target is early September, but we'll open committed capacity signups mid‑July. I'll post exact dates next week. For partner contracts, legal/finance should be looped in.
youssef: I can own the autoscaler runbook. Will draft a first pass and link it in eng-docs by Tue. cc @nick for SLO knobs and dashboard metrics.
nick: Happy to review and add the SLO dashboards. Planning to push bpf metrics and a sample dashboard by Fri.
tara: For customers that need earlier capacity we can offer a Dedicated beta. Who should field those inbound requests? @elaine?
elaine: Yes — please send beta interest to sales@redwood.com with subject 'dedicated-beta' and I'll triage. Also tag me in the ticket.
youssef: Starting repo (WIP): https://git.redwood/infra/autoscaler-template — will add the runbook there. Snippet of flags I'm testing:
```
--max-batch=256
--latency-slo-ms=50
--scale-down-delay=120
```
deploy-bot: Notice: Dedicated GA planning doc updated by ana — changelog: "GA timeline refined"
ana: I added provisional dates to the public roadmap doc: https://docs.redwood/roadmap/2026-q3 (see 'Dedicated' section). Feedback welcome.
elaine: Action items (copying here so folks can grab):
- ana: post final GA/commit signup dates by Mon (owner: ana)
- youssef: autoscaler runbook draft in eng-docs by Tue (owner: youssef)
- nick: dashboard + bpf metrics pushed by Fri (owner: nick)
- tara: compile weekly dedicated-beta request list and share (owner: tara)
I'll convert to Asana tasks and ping owners. Thanks all :raised_hands:
